text:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert for rw-inference-v2-quantized (run 2026-02-20T07:00Z)
- failed suites: conversational-qa (4/120 fail), summarization-regression (2/50 fail), safety-toxicity (3/200 fail)
- overall regression score delta: +6.3% compared to baseline
- top sample failures attached, stack: quantized fp16 -> q4f16 profile
Link: https://ci.redwood/inference/nightly/1742106423

maria: heads-up team, this popped up in the morning alert. can someone triage initial severity and owner?

jon: I skimmed the failures — most look like hallucinations in long-context QA, two are outright truncation in summarization. severity: P2 for now, P1 if we see user-facing regressions in prod. assigning tentatively to @lee and @sara.

lee: taking point on repro. first quick look: several examples show the model emitting repeated token loops around entity names. looks correlated with >1024 context windows and KV cache eviction logs. grabbing one dump now.

lee: ```
INPUT: "Given the 2019 report, summarize the main regulatory changes... [truncated long prompt]"
GOLD: "The 2019 report introduced X, Y, Z"
MODEL: "The report shows that the report shows that the report shows..."
```

sara: noted. I also see a spike in perplexity around the quantization profile switch (q4f16) last night. metrics: token-loss +0.4 on eval set, but the failure examples have catastrophic repeats. could be quantization edge case. tagging @devon for infra traces (KV cache behavior).

devon: I pulled the runtime logs for that model instance. found these warnings around 07:12Z: `kv_cache_evicted=true, eviction_strategy=age_based, chunk_size=64` and a related kernel fallback: `kernel=matmul_alt, fallback=true`. sending the traces to the thread.

maria: thanks. initial plan: (1) reproduce locally with the exact quantized artifact, (2) try same run with unquantized fp16 to see regression delta, (3) if repro is stable, do a quick canary rollback on Dedicated. Does that sound right?

jon: yes. severity bump rule: if repro reproduces on unquantized model -> regression is in model weights or prompt changes. if only with q4f16 -> quantization/regression. set severity P1 if customer-facing endpoints show similar hits.

lee: repro steps I'm doing:
```
# fetch nightly artifact
rwi artifact fetch rw-inference-v2-quantized --run 1742106423 --out ./artifact
# run local eval subset
python eval/run_suite.py --model ./artifact --suites conversational-qa summarization-regression --limit 20 --save-dump ./dumps/1742106423
```
I'll post dumps and a minimal failing prompt once I have it. ETA ~20m.

sara: I'll prepare a quick quantization-rollback (pin to q8f16) and run the same subset on infra to compare perf/cost impact. if that fixes quality we can do a canary.

devon: I've scheduled an infra trace for the exact job id and pinned the GPU kernel logs. also enabled deeper KV logging for the next run (low overhead).

maria: owner summary: @lee repro + sample dump, @sara investigate quantization rollback and quality delta, @devon infra traces. @jon will coordinate escalation if we need cross-team rollback. I'll open an issue and link this thread.

jon: +1. create issue with labels: regression, nightly-alert, quantization, owner-lee. set priority P2 for now.

maria: if anyone sees this become widespread in prod please ping #incidents and escalate. for now let's keep in eng-ml for triage.

lee: posted a minimal failing prompt and dump: https://s3.redwood/dumps/1742106423/minimal-fail.json. repro confirmed locally with quantized artifact; unquantized FP16 run does not exhibit the loop.

sara: ok that strongly points to quantization. running q8f16 vs q4f16 comparison now.

devon: KV eviction correlated with long contexts only; unrelated runs with short contexts show no kernel fallback. may be a combined effect (quantization + eviction).

maria: next actions:
- lee: attach failing generations to the issue and add deterministics (seed, prompt).
- sara: run q8f16 comparison and report quality delta (ETA 30m).
- devon: dig into eviction heuristics and see if a quick config tweak reduces occurrences.

jon: tagging for visibility: @eng-runtime @eng-ml. :eyes:

maria: thanks all. please update the issue and mark when we have a candidate fix for canary. :thumbsup:
